channel.title: Abhi Singh
channel.description: Notes on AI enablement: how organisations help people actually use AI at work.

item.title: UK amendment would let ministers set rules on AI agents
item.description: A proposed UK amendment would let ministers set rules on how organisations deploy and report on AI agents. It isn't law yet.

item.title: Gemini skills are personal. Sharing them is the organisation's job.
item.description: Gemini's new Customize hub lets each person build their own skills. Google's announcement describes admin controls for the connected apps, not the skills.

item.title: Edit a whole deck with Gemini in Slides
item.description: Gemini in Google Slides can now edit a whole deck from one prompt. There's no admin control for it.

item.title: Copilot gets Home, skills in Chat and an always-on agent
item.description: Microsoft's Copilot app now brings Chat and Cowork into one place. An always-on agent with its own mailbox is due on Frontier in November.

item.title: A policy exists, but does anyone know what's in it?
item.description: More than half of diginomica's digital leaders have an AI governance policy. Only 14% wrote it within the technology team alone.

item.title: Editing files inside Gemini chat
item.description: You can now create and edit files inside the Gemini chat, and there's no admin control specific to this feature.

item.title: Anthropic's reports on what AI spend produces
item.description: Anthropic now offers Claude Enterprise customers reports on what their AI spend produces. The vendor is helping to measure the value of its own product.

item.title: Walmart's 27% confidence gain
item.description: Walmart says associates who took OpenAI training reported a 27% confidence gain. It's an encouraging number, and it leaves the next question open.

item.title: Check the sources in Fill with Gemini
item.description: Fill with Gemini in Google Sheets now shows the web sources behind each cell. That makes a simple habit possible before anyone trusts a filled column.

item.title: Uber scales before showing pilot results
item.description: Uber is rolling ChatGPT Work out to more than 30,000 employees. The announcement doesn't say how the pilot went.

item.title: Improving my LinkedIn workflow on a Saturday afternoon
item.description: Today afternoon, I set out to improve the AI workflow behind my LinkedIn posts.
